top_signals.title: Trump’s Venezuela Fixer Is Promoting ‘America First’ Oil Deals
top_signals.summary: A Venezuelan mogul who minted a fortune selling power turbines and pumping oil has emerged as the Trump administration’s fixer for promoting “America First” deals for favored US companies, as Washington moves to exert more influence in the resource-rich South American country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Diana Shipping Withdraws Genco Offer
top_signals.summary: Diana Shipping has announced, that following nine months of what it called “avoiding engagement,” Genco Board has demanded consideration valued at approximately $36.91 per share — a 57% premium to Genco’s undisturbed share price at the time…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Data of 54,000 wallet users leaked, CLARITY odds just 10%: Hodler’s Digest
top_signals.summary: Owners of Trezor and SafePal crypto wallets at high risk of phishing attempts after separate data leaks, CLARITY odds at 10% despite White House meeting this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
